name: BOCCHI THE ROCK!
description: Hitori Gotoh, a shy, awkward, and lonely high school student dreams of being in a band despite her doubts and worries, but when she is recruited to be the guitarist of a group looking to make it big, she realises her dream may be able to be fulfilled and come true.

videos.title: Gotoh Futari's Big Sister Observation Diary
videos.overview: A  look back on the recent daily life of the main character, Hitori Gotoh, while her younger sister Futari Gotoh observes them.

videos.title: Lonely Rolling Bocchi
videos.overview: Introverted Bocchi takes up the guitar in hopes of meeting friends, but her social anxiety is not so easily conquered...

videos.title: See You Tomorrow
videos.overview: Nijika proposes that the band save up money for their next gig by doing part-time work at Starry.

videos.title: Be Right There
videos.overview: Bocchi decides to try to pursue a new vocalist for the band: a classmate named Kita.

videos.title: Jumping Girl(s)
videos.overview: While Bocchi struggles to write the lyrics to the band's first song, Nijika arranges a special band outing.

videos.title: Flightless Fish
videos.overview: Kessoku Band has their first song and they're ready to play their next concert, but Seika isn't so easily convinced.

videos.title: Eight Views
videos.overview: When Bocchi struggles with her need to sell concert tickets, a chance meeting with an eccentric character may be just what she needs.

videos.title: To Your House
videos.overview: It's a party at Bocchi's house when the girls come by to make T-shirt designs! But can she handle her first real friend visit?!

videos.title: Bocchi the Rock
videos.overview: The weather threatens to put a kibosh on enthusiasm for Kessoku Band's latest performance.

videos.title: Enoshima Escar
videos.overview: The girls take Bocchi out for one last blast before school resumes. Destination: Enoshima!

videos.title: After Dark
videos.overview: When Bocchi struggles with the decision of whether or not to perform at her school's culture festival, Kikuri arrives to offer inspiration.

videos.title: Duodecimal Sunset
videos.overview: The culture festival's rolled around, and the Kessoku Band girls want to enjoy it with Bocchi... if they can even find her first!

videos.title: Morning Light Falls on You
videos.overview: Kessoku Band's performance at the culture festival is on. Can the band make it through without disaster?
